name: Introduction to the HTTP Tool
description: Basic tutorial on using HTTP tools in n8n.

hints: "AI Agent" used agent tools in the original: Webscraper Tool (toolHttpRequest). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.

Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.

## Try It Out!

### The HTTP tool is drastically simplifies API-enabled AI agents cutting down the number of workflow nodes by as much as 10!

* Available since v1.47.0
* Recommended for single purpose APIs which don't require much post-fetch formatting.
* If you require a chain of API calls, you may need to implement a subworkflow instead.
